status != 'CANCELLED'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_purchase (member_id, product_name, category, image, unit_price, group_price, delivery_method, delivery_fee, delivery_date, description, target_quantity, deadline) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{productName}, #{category}, #{image}, #{unitPrice}, #{groupPrice}, #{deliveryMethod}, #{deliveryFee}, #{deliveryDate}, #{description}, #{targetQuantity}, #{deadline})
mapper.update: UPDATE group_purchase SET current_quantity = current_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE gp_id = #{gpId}
